title: F6 commercial kitchen
description: A dense commercial kitchen with cooking and prep counters, stocked pan shelving, cold storage, and a lifting-hood dishwasher at the dish-return line. Tasks cover cookware handling, dish return, appliance controls, and cotton towel and mat manipulation.

tasks.text: On the prep counter, pick up the sealed spice jar labeled “CHILLI” beside the row of four small stainless pans. Count the pans starting from the jar and place it in the third one (Hotel Pan Sixth). Release the jar upright and let it come to rest inside the pan.

locatorSteps.label: Pick up the sealed jar marked “CHILLI”.
Set it upright in the third pan from the jar and let go.

tasks.text: Find the row of four small stainless pans on the prep counter beside the sealed jar labeled “CHILLI”. Slide the pan nearest the jar (Hotel Pan Sixth) away from the aisle edge toward the middle of the counter. Leave it upright and still.

locatorSteps.label: Slide the pan nearest the CHILLI jar inward from the aisle.
Leave the pan upright and still on the counter.

tasks.text: Lift the top white plate from the stack beside the green bus tub on the pot sink landing. Turn the plate upright, seat it between the pegs of the grey plate rack beside the hood dishwasher and let go. Raise the dishwasher hood, align the loaded rack with the opening and slide it inside. Lower the hood, then raise it again. Move the rack onto the outlet table with the plate still standing. Lift the plate out, lay it flat on the stack farthest from the dishwasher on the drying shelf above the outlet table, and let go.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the top plate beside the green tub and turn it upright.
Stand it between the rack pegs and release it.
Raise the dishwasher hood.
Align the loaded rack and slide it into the dishwasher.
Lower the hood, then raise it again.
Move the loaded rack onto the outlet table.
Lift the plate out of the rack.
Lay it flat on the farthest drying-shelf stack and let go.

tasks.text: At the two-door reach-in fridge, open the door farthest from the refrigerated counter. Hold it open briefly. Swing it back against its frame, let go and check that it stays closed.

locatorSteps.label: Open the door farthest from the refrigerated counter.
Hold the door open briefly.
Close it against its frame and check that it stays shut.

tasks.text: Find the empty green bus tub on the landing beside the pot sink. Push it straight along the landing, away from the stack of white plates and toward the outer end. Release it and let it stop upright on the landing.

locatorSteps.label: Push the green tub away from the plates along the landing.
Let it stop upright near the outer end of the landing.

tasks.text: At the prerinse unit over the pot sink, turn the spray nozzle clear of its hook, then swing the hose arm over the basin. Open the hot tap and close it again. Swing the arm back, park the nozzle on the same hook and let go.

locatorSteps.label: Turn the spray nozzle clear of its hook.
Swing the hose arm over the sink basin.
Open the hot tap, then close it again.
Swing the arm back and park the nozzle on its hook.

tasks.text: Lift the wire cooking basket out of the boiler unit until the basket clears its rim. Carry it along the cooking line to the stainless corner worktable, set it on the worktop and let it come to rest upright.

locatorSteps.label: Lift the wire basket clear of the boiler rim.
Set it upright on the corner worktable and let go.

tasks.text: On the pan shelving across from the prep counter, take the stock pot on the bottom shelf closest to both the prep counter and the dish-return line. Pull it clear of the shelf, lift it and carry it around the dish-return end of the prep counter. Lower it onto the back burner nearest the boiler unit on the range with ovens. Let go and leave the pot level and still.

locatorSteps.label: Pull the stock pot clear of the bottom shelf and lift it.
Carry the pot around the dish-return end of the counter.
Set it on the back burner nearest the boiler and let go.
